title: jasminocereus thouarsii var. sclerocarpus
intro: Jasminocereus thouarsii var. sclerocarpus, commonly known as Night-blooming cereus, is a species of cactus in the family Cactaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Night-blooming cereus include wound healing, pain relief, and antiseptic properties, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides. The health benefits and therapeutic actions of Jasminocereus thouarsii var. sclerocarpus are still being researched and studied for their potential applications in traditional medicine.
